summary: Verified the three-batch Board Recruitment funnel (About Rooney, DIY $497, Do-It-With-Me proposal, shared intake). 17/17 backend pytest tests PASS (DIY checkout endpoint, direct-project checkout success_url now points at /board-recruitment-intake, intake context 404 for bogus/402 for pending, intake submit rejected for bogus, full happy-path submit + resubmit-is-upsert, plus SPA route smoke). Full DIY end-to-end validated in browser: click /recruit-your-board-yourself CTA -> Stripe test $497 pay with 4242 -> /purchase/success -> registered fresh diy-tester-<ts>@example.com -> redirected to /board-recruitment-intake?session_id=... (NOT Module 1). MongoDB verified: purchases.purchase_source=direct_diy_board_recruitment_497, entitlement=recruitment_self_guided, member.entitlements=['recruitment_self_guided'], payment_transactions.payment_status=paid. Intake form: 5 steps navigate cleanly with progress indicator 'Step X of 5', prefill filled name+email from the new member, LinkedIn Yes reveals URL fields, Present Board Not Sure checkboxes disable inputs, skills incl. Legal/Fundraising, Hybrid reveals Meeting Location + Virtual Meeting Information, Max Board Size Not Specified checkbox stores 'Not Specified / I Don't Know', Open Until Positions Are Filled path works. Submit -> intake-done card + auto-navigation to https://calendly.com/boardbuilder/recruitboard (captured via route.abort, not followed). board_recruitment_intakes row contains session_id, purchase_source, user_id + LinkedIn Yes/No + URLs; recruitment_profiles doc for that user_id has data.organization_name/mission/city/board_kind and strategy_intake.meeting_frequency/format/board_term. Duplicate submit is idempotent (upsert by session_id). About Rooney page: photo/name 'Rooney Akpesiri'/title 'The Nonprofit Board Builder' (rendered uppercase via CSS)/mission all present, TestimonialCarousel idPrefix about-rooney renders 8 canonical testimonials including Pastor Cyrena Denniston, DIY $497 & DWM $1,998.50 offer cards route to /recruit-your-board-yourself and /board-recruitment-proposal with the exact button labels, no payment form on this page, mobile 390px shows no horizontal scroll. DIY page: exact hero, section headings ('You Don't Have to Figure Out...', 'When You Finish', 'Your Investment' with $497, 'One payment.' + 'No monthly membership.'), primary CTA text and cross-link to proposal. Proposal page: hero contains ONLY eyebrow + H1 'Build the Board Your Nonprofit Needs' + supporting line (no other children besides decorative i), brp-summary-section rendered below hero in white area, exact CTA text "MAKE PAYMENT — LET'S START RECRUITING YOUR BOARD TOGETHER", cross-link to /recruit-your-board-yourself, 8 canonical testimonials at bottom below CTA. Intake gating: /board-recruitment-intake with no session shows intake-blocked; with cs_bogus_12345 also blocked (after 402/404 poll); links to both offer pages present. Cancelled banners: /recruit-your-board-yourself?checkout=cancelled shows dyi-cancelled-notice; /board-recruitment-proposal?checkout=cancelled shows brp-cancelled-notice with the exact 'Your payment was not completed. You can get started whenever you're ready.' copy. DWM full Stripe UI purchase was NOT re-run (would create a real $1,998.50 test-mode session identical to DIY plumbing) but the direct-project-checkout endpoint was verified to build the correct success_url=/board-recruitment-intake?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID} and cancel_url=/board-recruitment-proposal?checkout=cancelled with amount=199850, and the intake happy-path was executed against a seeded direct_board_recruitment_project session, so both branches of the intake context endpoint are proven. Regression: /, /recruit, /recruit-with-rooney, /reactivate, /activate, /join-a-board still return the SPA shell.
critical_code_review_comments: Non-blocking (pre-existing): unauthenticated /api/members/me on public funnel pages continues to log a console 401. Consider swallowing the 401 or gating the call by a token check to reduce noise in Sentry / Chrome console.

Non-blocking: board_intake_routes.py's verified_transaction uses HTTPException(status_code=404) both for 'no purchase' and for 'purchase_source not in QUALIFYING_SOURCES'. If a legitimate purchase exists with a different source it will look like 'not found' to the frontend. Consider 403 for the latter for future debuggability.

Non-blocking: BoardRecruitmentIntakePage effect polls context every 2.5s up to 8 attempts (20s) on 402 (pending). Users landing off a still-processing session may wait a while before auto-transition — acceptable but a visible countdown or friendlier interim copy would help.

Non-blocking: RecruitYourBoardYourselfPage.makePayment on axios failure only sets a generic notice; still no logging of error.response.data.detail to aid support diagnosis (same pattern in BoardRecruitmentProposalPage).
Minor DRY: three of the four checkout endpoints in payment_routes.py duplicate the managed_payments/automatic_tax fallback block; extracting a helper would reduce ~35 lines of duplicated code.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on all requested flows (DIY paid E2E + 5-step intake submit executed live; DWM checkout endpoint verified via API + intake happy-path via seeded paid session)

test_credentials: None required beyond Stripe test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (used one live DIY test-mode payment $497). Admin creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed for these public flows.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_batch_intake_e2e.py (17 tests, runs in ~5s). It uses a seeded paid transaction (purchase_source=direct_board_recruitment_project) to exercise intake context+submit without paying — no need to burn Stripe sessions on repeat runs. If you want a fresh DIY E2E, use /recruit-your-board-yourself and note the Stripe checkout requires: click 'Card' radio, fill cardNumber/expiry/CVC, billingName, billingAddressLine1, billingLocality, billingPostalCode, billingPhone, uncheck input[name='enableStripePass']. PurchaseSuccessPage registration uses testids register-first-name/register-last-name/register-email/register-password/register-confirm-password (NOT name= attributes). Intake page redirect after submit is a full location.replace to https://calendly.com/boardbuilder/recruitboard — intercept via page.route abort if you don't want to leave the domain.
